answer: A new identity starts at zero, below the terrace of trusted peers, and must climb to zenith reputation through attested tasks. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent stakes collateral locked to a verified hardware root, and reputation accrues on a public ledger mapping identity to work history, like an atlas charting every participant. Creating N fakes costs N stakes plus sustained compute, making forgery economically irrational since rewards stay locked until real contributions verify. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
